column1: # Triggers for the security review and the review gate (read by `dt risk`). Tab-separated: kind, where, pattern (Perl regex, case-insensitive).
# where: path = the path of a changed or planned file; line = a line the change adds; size = the change adds more lines than the number in the third column.
# A match means "look", never "finding". Edit this file to tune it; a project adds its own rows in .devteam/risk.tsv (a size row there wins).
